units.source_text: 源氏乘此机会，婉转其词地向他说出了玉鬘之事。

en.t: Taking this opportunity, Genji tactfully told him about Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 内大臣听了，感慨地说：“唉，此人真可怜，此事太稀奇了！”

en.t: When the Minister of the Interior heard this, he said with deep emotion, "Ah, how pitiful she is, and how extraordinary this matter is!"

units.source_text: 说着就哭起来。

en.t: As he spoke, he began to weep.

units.source_text: 后来又说：“当时我很担心，曾经四处寻访。

en.t: After a while he went on, "At the time I was terribly worried, and I searched everywhere for her.

units.source_text: 其间不知因何机缘，由于忧愁不堪，曾将此事向你泄露。

en.t: During that time, by some strange turn of fate, I was so overwhelmed with sorrow that I once let the matter slip to you.

units.source_text: 现今我已成为略有地位之人，

en.t: Now that I have become a man of some standing,

units.source_text: 想起当年浪迹人间，生下许多芜杂的子女，

en.t: when I think back on the years when I drifted through the world and fathered many children here and there,

units.source_text: 一任他们流落在各处，实在有伤体面，而且甚是可耻。

en.t: leaving them scattered in different places is truly damaging to my dignity and deeply shameful.

units.source_text: 设法把他们收回家来一看，又觉得很可怜爱。

en.t: Yet when I manage to bring them home and see them, I find them very dear and pitiful.

units.source_text: 我首先想起的正是这个女儿。”

en.t: The one I thought of first was precisely this daughter."

units.source_text: 说到这里，回忆起了从前雨夜品评时任情不拘地所作的种种评语，

en.t: Having said this, they recalled the many unrestrained remarks they had once made during the rainy-night discussion of women,

units.source_text: 时而哭泣，时而嬉笑，两人都无所顾忌了。

en.t: and at times they cried, at times they laughed, until both of them had cast aside all reserve.

units.source_text: 夜色已深，各自准备回家。

en.t: The night had grown late, and each of them prepared to go home.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“今天在此相会，回想起遥远的少年时代旧事，

en.t: Genji said, "Meeting here today and remembering those distant events from our youth,

units.source_text: 教人眷恋往昔，难于堪忍，我竟不想回去了。”

en.t: I feel such longing for the past that it is hard to bear, and I no longer want to go home."

units.source_text: 源氏平素并不十分感伤，此次想是酒后之故，欷歔地哭起来。

en.t: Genji was not usually so sentimental, but perhaps because of the wine this time, he began to sob.

units.source_text: 太君更不必说，

en.t: As for the grand lady, there was even less need to say anything.

units.source_text: 她看见这女婿相貌比前更好、权势比前更大，

en.t: Seeing that this son-in-law was more handsome than before and held even greater power,

units.source_text: 便想起了女儿葵姬，痛惜她的早死，不胜悲伤，

en.t: she thought of her daughter Lady Aoi, grieved over her early death, and was overcome with sorrow,

units.source_text: 也抽抽噎噎地哭起来，眼泪淌个不住。

en.t: so she too began to sob, and her tears flowed without stopping.

units.source_text: 那尼姑打扮的姿态特别令人感动。

en.t: Her appearance in nun's attire was especially moving.
